implementation_summary: Implemented D049 RCAB snapshot/live separation: (1) added machine-visible epoch snapshot semantics to committed manifest (snapshot_type=epoch, snapshot_semantics=evidence_snapshot_not_live_authority, schema 1.1.0 with 1.0.0 backward compat); (2) added build_live_status() computing current registry integrity, registered content measurements, and bootstrap/router warning state directly from current docs/CONTEXT-MAP.md plus current tracked registered files, never trusting committed snapshot measurements; (3) added validate_snapshot_integrity() for internal canonical integrity validation without currentness comparison; (4) kept check_manifest() as explicit deliberate currentness comparison; (5) refactored shared projection into _compute_rcab_projection(); (6) added --live-status and --validate-snapshot CLI modes; (7) refreshed committed manifest as epoch snapshot with 1.1.0 fields; (8) replaced failing test_manifest_cli_check_on_real_repository with integrity-based test_manifest_snapshot_integrity_on_real_repository; (9) added 15 T032-specific tests mapping AC-T032-1 through AC-T032-6.

commands: uv run ruff check tools/repository_context.py tests/test_repository_context.py
uv run ruff format --check tools/repository_context.py tests/test_repository_context.py
